In-house sports interest page · not a client engagement · 2026 · published around relevant cricket announcements

Moving quickly when the audience is paying attention

Two timely cricket posts recorded 515,552 and 57,872 views. Both were published without paid promotion, according to the supplied post insights.

My role

I followed cricket news, spotted the relevant announcements, planned the posts and coordinated quick publishing. This was an internal interest page, not a paid client account.

Sector

Organic strategy · Sports / attention moments

Status

Case study / supplied platform screenshot

Topics

Timely publishing · Organic distribution · In-house project

01 / Starting point

The challenge

Most posts earned a few thousand views. When major cricket announcements happened, I needed to spot the moment, get the creative ready and publish while people were searching for the news.

The insight

For news-led content, timing matters. A simple, accurate post published at the right time can do better than a more elaborate post that comes too late.

02 / The approach

The plan

  • Keep an eye on announcements the audience is waiting for.
  • Make the creative clear and easy to understand.
  • Publish while the news is still relevant, then review the post results.
03 / Execution

Make the rhythm visible.

Monitoring

I followed cricket announcements and picked moments when interest was unusually high.

Content

I planned the creative and captions to match what fans were searching for.

Publishing

I helped get the posts out quickly, without paid boosting.

Results

I checked views and interactions after the posts went live. These are organic post metrics, not business results.

06 / Selected proof

A closer look at the work.

These examples include dates and sources so you can see what they show and what they do not.

04 / Results

Evidence with the label still attached.

Supplied Instagram post insights show 515,552 views, 20,768 interactions and 2,246 profile actions on the schedule announcement. The separate squad announcement shows 57,872 views, 4,675 interactions and 502 profile actions. These are separate organic post results, not business leads or brand sales.

05 / Reflection

What stays after the campaign?

The posts show what fast, relevant publishing can achieve. They are organic engagement results, not evidence of sales or client acquisition.
